svg.aria-label: Engineering philosophy: the safe state is the default state. Fail-closed: Production stays dark until an owner approves go-live, so nothing reaches the public by accident. Infrastructure as code: Every environment-facing decision is written as code and reviewed before it takes effect. Drift shows up in a diff. Review-gated: Destructive or sensitive actions require deliberate human approval, and every change is recoverable.
